test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required' if the sentence is correct as given.**

(**Many man**) has tried to find the caves but none have succeeded.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Many a man". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Many man' **is incorrect.
 
• The phrase **'Many a man' **means **'more than one man'.**
 
• The phrase **'Many a man' **is used to refer to a number of men.
 
• The plural form of man is **'men', **but **'man' **is used in this phrase because it is followed by a vowel.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **'Many a man'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Many a men' is incorrect because 'men' is already plural.
 
• 'No correction required' is incorrect because the sentence contains an error.
 
• 'Much man' is incorrect because 'much' is an adjective that means 'a large quantity'.
